description: The fourteen Anytype adoption items 047's research ranked against src/views: a filter/sort chip row with state-dependent trigger icons, landing in view settings after a view is made, a sticky board scrollbar, duplicate view, per-view scroll restore, cell-editor edge flip, sort-conflict confirmation, capability-gated menus, two-flavour empty states, per-view new-row presets, positionLock, measured toolbar collapse, per-format phone filter rows, and an inline Load more row — each designed against a real capture before it is written
